tabs.label: Product
tabs.title: i.e ERP — Manufacturing Command Centre
tabs.description: One platform for finance, HR, CRM, inventory, production planning, and dispatch — configured around your routings and your approval chains, not a template. We study how your plant works before a single screen is deployed.
outcomes: Run finance, inventory, production, and sales on one live data model instead of five disconnected tools
Automate invoicing, approvals, procurement, and reporting that your team currently does by hand
See revenue, expenses, work orders, and pipeline in real time on dashboards built for your roles

tabs.label: Product
tabs.title: i.e ERP — Restaurant Management System
tabs.description: Point-of-sale, kitchen, inventory, and rooms in one integrated system for restaurants, hotels, and multi-outlet hospitality groups — deployed and supported by the team that built it.
outcomes: Real-time billing and POS across every outlet, synced to one back office
Ingredient-level consumption tracking with automatic purchase suggestions
Tables, reservations, digital menus, and room service handled in the same system

tabs.label: Product
tabs.title: AI-Assisted CAD Workspace
tabs.description: A cloud-native CAD environment where AI assists with geometry, constraints, and simulation — built for engineering teams that iterate fast and can't afford seats sitting idle.
outcomes: Cut design iteration cycles with AI-assisted part generation and constraint handling
Resolve complex assemblies faster with engineering-grade constraint intelligence
Collaborate in real time, with guided onboarding for distributed design teams
